title: Decision within a time bound
statement: A finite oracle nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet decides a language $L$ in time $T$ relative to an oracle language $O$ if, for every Boolean input string $x$, every choice sequence of length $T(|x|)$ leads to a halting run with oracle $O$, and $x$ belongs to $L$ exactly when the machine accepts $x$ within $T(|x|)$ steps relative to $O$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite oracle nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
An oracle language over the Boolean alphabet
A language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet
A function $T$ from natural numbers to natural numbers
For every Boolean input string $x$, the machine halts within $T(|x|)$ steps relative to $O$
For every Boolean input string $x$, membership in $L$ is equivalent to acceptance within $T(|x|)$ steps relative to $O$
